evidence.quote: rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on

observations.why: Mandating a recurring rehearsal cadence appeals to security/stability (conservation) and to maintaining capability through practice (competence).

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have

observations.why: Equating unrehearsed with non-existent frames preparedness as the measure of real capability (competence) and security (conservation).
Restating the cadence as a fixed label appeals to stability and routine as the governing good.
Claiming ownership titles the speaker as accountable principal, appealing to standing and achievement.
